gaps.explanation: Both 'happiness' and 'money' are general here, so no article for either gap.

gaps.sentence: The car crashed into a wall at ___ speed of 90 km/h.
gaps.explanation: 'At a speed of…' — 'a' is part of this fixed phrase.

gaps.sentence: The thief was sent to ___ prison for three years.
gaps.explanation: 'Sent to prison' — the institution, no article; 'the prison' would mean the building.

gaps.sentence: I live on ___ Baker Street, near the tube station.
gaps.explanation: Street names take no article: Baker Street, Oxford Street.

gaps.sentence: ___ Netherlands borders both Belgium and Germany.

gaps.explanation: 'The courage he showed' — the relative clause makes it definite.
'Inflation' as a general economic concept takes no article.
Single mountain peaks take no article: Everest, Mont Blanc (compare: the Alps).
